ProjectFocus.target.cfg.ref: Target focus at 3 projects and Home, 3 requests, 1 library change, budget 2, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry; every safety property holds. The plan's 4 requests run in wide, which keeps the pr tier short.

ProjectFocus.target-one-project.cfg.ref: Budget 1 at the target bounds: the registry closes the session being left through its close flush, focus never closes, and every safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.target-idle-expiry.cfg.ref: Idle expiry at any step at the target bounds; every safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.target-person-commands.cfg.ref: Two person opens and two closes interleaved with 3 requests over 3 projects, no Home, no library change; OpenCarriesRequest and every other safety property hold.

ProjectFocus.target-same-project.cfg.ref: 2 projects, 2 chats, 4 requests, 1 library change, budget 2; a same-project commit keeps the editor with at most one ChatForwarded, and every safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.target-open-facts.cfg.ref: Facts in any order over 2 projects, 3 requests, 1 library change, 1 person open and close; EditorOnlyWhenReady, FirstCheckBeforeEditor and every other safety property hold.

ProjectFocus.liveness.cfg.ref: LiveSpec over 2 projects and Home, 3 requests, 1 library change, budget 1; RequestEventuallySettles holds.

ProjectFocus.today-late-effect.cfg.ref: Today with the late registration at the target bounds: an edit before ProjectPersistenceGuard registers the flush, then a navigation, leaves without a flush. A witness of the registration window, not of the request fence.

ProjectFocus.today-superseded-open.cfg.ref: Today at 3 projects and Home, 3 requests, no library change; a request superseded during the leave flush is fenced and the today safety properties hold.

ProjectFocus.today-superseded-open-reach.ref: Today, no library change: the superseded-during-flush interleaving is reachable, so today-superseded-open is not vacuous.

ProjectFocus.today-stale-return.cfg.ref: Today at the target bounds: returning to the resolved project after a library change opens it on the stale answer. A witness for A5a, whose open needs a ready answer for the current epoch.

ProjectFocus.today-library-retry.cfg.ref: Today at the target bounds: a library change re-runs the access effect after a failed leave flush and leaves flushFailed without Retry. A witness; whether the target keeps that retry is open for A5a.

ProjectFocus.today-module-race.cfg.ref: U1 at the target bounds: today derives editor while the project runtime import is still loading.

ProjectFocus.today-first-check.cfg.ref: U13 and U20 at the target bounds: today derives editor before the first file check settles and before the open bound.

ProjectFocus.no-request-id.cfg.ref: At the target bounds without the id fence, the answer for an older request focuses its project under a newer request: the id is necessary.

ProjectFocus.no-route-in-selector.cfg.ref: At the target bounds a selector without the committed route shows the previous request's state for a route focus has not taken: the selector needs the route.

ProjectFocus.match-by-request-id.cfg.ref: At the target bounds with two chats, matching by request id tears the editor down on a chat switch: the comparison must be by project.

ProjectFocus.export.cfg.ref: The labelled export at 2 projects and Home, 3 requests, no library change or failure; every safety property holds.

ProjectFocus.wide.cfg.ref: Nightly: 4 projects and Home, 4 requests, 1 library change, budget 2, 1 failed leave flush, 1 retry; every safety property holds. The plan named 6 requests and 2 library changes; 4 requests with 2 library changes already take about 15 minutes (10.9M distinct states), the nightly watchdog, so wide keeps 1 library change.
